about: Rev3.0 GlassFront fit assembly (stage 2, updated to GF-1.1 in stage 3): frame 'Frame GF' + glass, optical bond, Formex, bead, VHB strips, oven sheet with fastener variants S4 (default) / R4 / S8, board STEP with DS1 at Z_PANEL_BACK. Units mm; plan coordinates abs KiCad (x, y down); model X = x, Y = -y, Z 0 = PCB back, -Z = front.

how_driven.Bead: ring bead_edge..bead_edge + bead_w inside the glass edge (corner R_glass - ...), Z_LAND..Z_GLASS_BACK (t_bond), dia pip_d holes at the 8 pips
how_driven.VHB tape strips: 4 straight strips s_tape_in..s_tape_out, ends tape_margin before the dia pad_d pads at F1-F4, Z_SHEET_BACK..Z_FLANGE_FRONT (t_gap)
how_driven.Oven sheet: flange outline + sheet_margin (40), R flange_R + sheet_margin, cut-out s_cut (corner R_cut 7.55), Z_GLASS_FRONT..Z_SHEET_BACK (t_sheet); R4 body adds dia riv_hole at F1-F4
how_driven.Weld studs S4 F1-F4 / S8 F5-F8: stud_d x stud_l from Z_SHEET_BACK + ISO 13918 PT weld flange stud_fl_d x stud_fl_k, at f<k>_x / f<k>_y
how_driven.Washers + nyloc nuts S4 / Washers, nuts,: DIN 9021 M4 (w4_*) on Z_TUBE_TOP, ISO 10511 M4 hex nut_s x nut_m on the washer; S8 spacers DIN 988 spacer_id x spacer_od x t_gap between sheet and flange
how_driven.Rivets R4: dome head riv_head_d x riv_head_k (edge R riv_head_k - 0.2) in front of the sheet, shank riv_d to the washer top, blind head envelope riv_blind_d x riv_blind_h (ASSUMED), DIN 9021 M5 (w5_*) backing washers on Z_TUBE_TOP
how_driven.Check - socket cylinders: dia socket_d from Z_TUBE_TOP + w4_t to socket_top at F1-F8

tails_treatment: The DS1 model's tails are rigid solids. The whole DS1 occurrence (panel AND tails AND fingers) was moved by -0.80 in Z. Consequences: (1) the tail legs attached to the panel edge and the U-loop fronts are where they really are (front-most CTP leg at Z -9.855 = Z_LOOP_FRONT -9.85 within 0.005); (2) the return legs and fingers are 0.80 too far forward: in reality the U-loops open up by 0.8 (U radius TFT 5.0 -> 5.4, CTP 5.55 -> 5.95, concept 3c) and the fingers stay in J10 / J11; in the model the fingers overlap the PCB (TFT 8.8 mm3, CTP 2.45 mm3) - an artefact; (3) the loop bottoms keep their v2 y (in reality they rise by 0.02-0.44), so y-clearances to the pocket bottom face are conservative. Every tail distance is therefore given twice: model position (correct for the panel-side legs and loop fronts) and v2 position (a temporary copy moved back +0.80: correct for the return legs / fingers).

1_interference_frame_vs_every_body.verdict: GF-1.1 (counterbore 7.4 x 9.0): 0 overlap between the frame and every part, with the nominal flange 5.5 x 0.7 and with the worst-case 5.7 x 1.4 (S4 / S8 studs 0.2 below the F1-F4 counterbore floor, 0.6 at F5-F8; one stud modelled at its extreme positions: flange >= 0.098 from the F1 counterbore floor round, >= 0.119 from the walls; the pads and the seat ring touch the sheet with 0 overlap = the frame seats). S8 DIN 988 7 x 13 x 1.0 shims: 0.75 radial to the 5.5 flange, 0.65 to 5.7 (round 3), flat on the flange front. R4 (round 3): dia-14 large-flange heads, rivet shank 0.305 from the slot, 0 overlap. Stage-2 findings F1 / F2 closed. No board body touches the frame; PCB 0.080 above the boss / rib / wall tops (copper + mask).

4_tails.treatment: The DS1 model's tails are rigid solids. The whole DS1 occurrence (panel AND tails AND fingers) was moved by -0.80 in Z. Consequences: (1) the tail legs attached to the panel edge and the U-loop fronts are where they really are (front-most CTP leg at Z -9.855 = Z_LOOP_FRONT -9.85 within 0.005); (2) the return legs and fingers are 0.80 too far forward: in reality the U-loops open up by 0.8 (U radius TFT 5.0 -> 5.4, CTP 5.55 -> 5.95, concept 3c) and the fingers stay in J10 / J11; in the model the fingers overlap the PCB (TFT 8.8 mm3, CTP 2.45 mm3) - an artefact; (3) the loop bottoms keep their v2 y (in reality they rise by 0.02-0.44), so y-clearances to the pocket bottom face are conservative. Every tail distance is therefore given twice: model position (correct for the panel-side legs and loop fronts) and v2 position (a temporary copy moved back +0.80: correct for the return legs / fingers).
4_tails.verdict: GF-1.1 (pocket side walls +0.3): CTP 1.830 (front leg -> side wall x 38.89), TFT 1.832 to the side wall, 1.763 to the bottom face (y 147.82), 1.789 to the R1.5 bottom corner - all >= 1.5 (target), the bottom beam >= 1.6 so loop_clr stays 1.5. The model's TFT minimum 1.445 is the return leg 0.8 too far forward over the Z 0 rib near J10 (rigid-shift artefact; 1.777 in the v2 position). Print / glass back: CTP 1.565, TFT 2.865; bead: TFT 5.63, CTP 12.97.
